schema_binding.embedded_schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://grandchallenge.ai/schemas/GCL-AGENT-CONTINUITY-ADOPTION-001.schema.json",
  "title": "GCL Agent Continuity Adoption",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "schema_version",
    "adoption_id",
    "policy_id",
    "version",
    "authority_repository",
    "authority_path",
    "repository",
    "binding_surface",
    "required",
    "specialization",
    "local_validator",
    "authority_preservation",
    "specialization_data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {"const": "GCL-AGENT-CONTINUITY-ADOPTION-001"},
    "schema_version": {"const": "1.0.0"},
    "adoption_id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "policy_id": {"const": "GCL-AGENT-CONTINUITY-001"},
    "version": {"const": "1.0.0"},
    "authority_repository": {"const": "grandchallenge/INTELLECT"},
    "authority_path": {"const": "governance/agent_execution/GCL-AGENT-CONTINUITY-001.md"},
    "repository": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^grandchallenge/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$"},
    "binding_surface": {"const": "AGENTS.md"},
    "required": {"const": true},
    "specialization": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
    "local_validator": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "authority_preservation": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["authority_changed"],
      "properties": {
        "authority_changed": {"const": false}
      },
      "additionalProperties": {"type": "boolean"}
    },
    "specialization_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": true
    }
  }
}
